description.value: Sushi Langford is a casual Japanese restaurant in Langford serving fresh sushi, rolls, sashimi, tempura, and noodle dishes made with a blend of Japanese ingredients and local products. Located in a strip mall on Millstream Road, it offers both lunch and dinner service and sits along cycling routes through the Westshore communities of Greater Victoria.
